title: 36 Hours in Door County, Wis.
abstract: Spend a weekend exploring the forest preserves, cliff-lined shores and walkable towns of this peninsula that juts out into Lake Michigan.

title: 36 Hours in Lima, Peru
abstract: Swim with sea lions, cycle along the coast, and gorge on ceviche and fried-fish sandwiches in Peru’s underappreciated capital.

title: 36 Hours in Malmo, Sweden
abstract: Admire art in a 17th-century castle, steam in a seaside bathhouse and unwind with an afternoon fika (coffee-and-cake break) in this diverse Swedish city.

title: 36 Hours in Stowe, Vermont
abstract: Spend a weekend sampling I.P.A.s and cider doughnuts, touring an enchanted sugar forest and relaxing in an Adirondack chair in this quaint city at the foot of Mount Mansfield.
